responsibility: Declares the analyzer’s internal logging API. It provides the logger class for structured formatted trace output, RAII log_scope helpers and LOG_* macros for function/scope tracing, and the log_user wrapper used throughout the analyzer to optionally attach a shared logger to engine, graph, and model objects without hardwiring logging behavior into their logic.
same_name_distinction: Declares the logger, log_scope, and log_user types plus LOG_* tracing macros and inline wrappers. Unlike analyzer-logging.cc, it is the public logging interface and RAII scaffolding used across the analyzer, not the out-of-line implementation.
